title: Inspection Certificate (Related to Article 13)
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Table 3] <Amended 2021.9.7>

Inspection Certificate (Related to Article 13)

| Inspection certificate |
|---|
| ① ____________________ |
| INSPECTION CERTIFICATE |
| ②: Applicant for inspection ____________________ |
| ③: Model number ____________________ |
| ④: Approval number ____________________ |
| ⑤: Inspection validity period ____________________ |
| ⑥: Inspector ____________________ Signature ____________________ |
| (Head of the inspection institution) ____________________ Official seal |

<Design Instructions>

1. A rectangle at least 90 mm wide and 60 mm high, or a circle at least 70 mm in diameter.

2. Method of indication
① The name of the machinery or equipment subject to inspection.
② Applicant for inspection: Enter the manufacturer's name; for imported goods, enter the importer's name; for periodic inspections, enter the user's name or the corresponding trade name.
③ For the model number, enter the model number, symbol, or other identifier specifying the equipment subject to inspection, and, where necessary, also enter the place of installation (location).
④ Enter the approval number (inspection certificate number).
⑤ For the validity period, enter the year, month, and day on which the equipment passed the inspection and the year, month, and day on which its validity expires.
⑥ Affix the name of the head of the inspection institution and the official seal.

3. Other Matters
(1) Materials that are not easily erased or worn away and a method of indication that makes the contents readily legible shall be used.
(2) For exported goods or similar cases, English wording may be used instead.
(3) Different colors may be used according to the type of inspection, the year of inspection, or other such factors.
